newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: ECNZ reports June yr net profit of NZ$324 mln.
newsitem.headline: ECNZ reports June yr net profit of NZ$324 mln.

text.p: State power generator Electricity Corp of New Zealand on Thursday reported a net profit of NZ$324 million in the year to June 30 against $385 million in the previous year.
ECNZ said it paid $1.634 billion to the government over the year, comprising $1.416 billion in dividends and $218 million in income tax.
Ordinary dividends for the year totalled $243 million and a special dividend of $1.173 billion was paid following the sale of assets on Febuary 1, 1996.

ECNZ said it was likely to pay another special dividend of $158 million on March 31, 1997. This follows a $655 million revaluation of ECNZ's assets, which lifts the corporation's value to $3.275 billion. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746
